block.event_trigger.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.event_trigger.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.event_trigger.model.title: Event Trigger
block.event_trigger.model.description: Emit bounded timer, calendar or stable-file events while the Run is active.
block.event_trigger.help_mode: Choose one source. Active Runtime starts listening at Run; One Shot only previews.
block.event_trigger.help_interval_sec: First tick after this delay. Missed ticks are coalesced, not replayed.
block.event_trigger.help_daily_time: 24-hour HH:MM. Nonexistent DST times are skipped; repeated times fire once.
block.event_trigger.help_timezone: IANA timezone, for example UTC or Europe/Paris; never inferred from the browser.
block.event_trigger.help_weekdays: Selected days: 0 Monday through 6 Sunday. At least one day.
block.event_trigger.help_watch_directory: Existing local directory. Direct files only; symlinks and subdirectories are not followed.
block.event_trigger.help_pattern: Filename pattern such as *.pdf. No path separators or recursive traversal.
block.event_trigger.help_stable_sec: Unchanged size and timestamps for this many seconds, observed at least twice.
block.event_trigger.help_include_existin: At Run only, emit current matching files after stability. Resume never replays the baseline.
block.event_trigger.help_start_paused: Wait for a data command {action: resume}; no hidden UI-to-runtime channel.
block.event_trigger.help_payload: Static JSON object attached to events, up to 4 KiB. No secrets or executable expressions.
block.event_trigger.help_poll_sec: Time between directory snapshots. Pause and Stop remain checked every 100 ms.
block.event_trigger.help_max_entries: Maximum directory entries examined. Exceeding the bound pauses the source with an explicit error.
block.event_trigger.help_max_pending: Bounded local event queue. Overflow pauses detection and reports rejected events.
block.event_trigger.help_emit_per_sec: Maximum graph publications per second; no burst catch-up after pauses.
